entries.title: Halo: Combat Evolved
entries.definitive_edition: Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary in The Master Chief Collection on Windows

primary.version: Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary in The Master Chief Collection
primary.why: Halo: Combat Evolved launched on Xbox, later reached Windows and Mac, and its Anniversary remaster became part of The Master Chief Collection on Xbox One and Windows. The Windows MCC version is the best archive route because it includes Anniversary and classic visuals, modern display options, and the strongest capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Halo: The Master Chief Collection on Windows and install the Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary component. Toggle classic/anniversary visuals as needed for comparison captures.

entries.remaster_caveats: Anniversary visuals alter presentation; use the in-game classic/anniversary toggle to preserve both looks.

entries.title: Halo: Spartan Assault
entries.definitive_edition: Windows main route plus Xbox One co-op secondary

emulation.notes: Native Windows; Xbox One secondary for co-op.

primary.why: Halo: Spartan Assault released on Windows, Windows Phone, Xbox One, Xbox 360, Steam, and iOS. Windows is the best main route because it has the best display/capture ceiling, but the Xbox versions added a cooperative mode that is not part of the Windows-first main route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows release for the main campaign. If preserving exclusive modes, also play the Xbox One co-op mode separately.

secondary.what_to_play: Play the Xbox co-op mode only; do not replay the full campaign.
secondary.why: The Xbox versions added a cooperative mode, while Windows remains the higher-fidelity capture route for the main campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: Windows Phone and older mobile availability may be limited by store delisting.

entries.title: Halo: The Master Chief Collection

primary.why: The Master Chief Collection released on Xbox One, later came to Windows, and was enhanced for Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route for the collection because it exposes the highest capture/settings ceiling across the MCC campaigns and multiplayer package.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows release on Steam or Microsoft Store and install the desired campaign components.

entries.remaster_caveats: Collection entry is a package-level route; individual campaigns are still represented as their own entries.

entries.title: Halo: Spartan Strike

primary.why: Halo: Spartan Strike released on Windows, Windows Phone, and iOS. Windows is the best archive route because it has the strongest display/capture path and no sourced exclusive content exists on the mobile versions.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows release through Steam or Microsoft Store if available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile availability may be limited by store delisting.

entries.title: Halo 5: Guardians

primary.why: Halo 5: Guardians is an Xbox One title and does not have a full Windows campaign release. The Xbox One version, playable on newer Xbox consoles through compatibility, is therefore the only sourced full-game archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Xbox One release on Xbox One or a compatible newer Xbox console. Do not treat Halo 5: Forge on Windows as the full game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No full PC release is sourced; avoid conflating Halo 5: Forge with the complete game.

entries.title: Halo Wars 2

primary.why: Halo Wars 2 released on Windows and Xbox One. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest display/capture ceiling and the same campaign content path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through the Microsoft Store/Xbox app ecosystem.

entries.remaster_caveats: No Steam release is sourced for the full game; use the Microsoft/Xbox PC route.

entries.title: Halo Recruit

primary.why: Halo Recruit was released as a short free Windows Mixed Reality experience. No non-WMR port is sourced, so the original Windows Mixed Reality route is the archive target.
primary.how_to_play: Use a compatible Windows Mixed Reality setup and a legitimately retained install if available.

entries.remaster_caveats: Short VR promotional experience; availability may be limited by WMR storefront/device support.

entries.title: Halo: Fireteam Raven

primary.why: Halo: Fireteam Raven is a cooperative arcade shooter released as a dedicated arcade cabinet. No home port is sourced, so the arcade cabinet is the only complete archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an original Halo: Fireteam Raven arcade cabinet if available; document cabinet revision and capture setup.

entries.remaster_caveats: No home port is sourced; do not substitute unofficial recreations for the archive route.

entries.title: Halo Infinite

primary.why: Halo Infinite released on Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows is the best archive route because it has the highest settings/capture ceiling while sharing the same campaign and live-service content base.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam or the Xbox app. Verify current seasonal/content availability before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service multiplayer content rotates; verify current availability during archival capture.
